description:
Saneagle 350W Electric Bike: Reliable Power for Casual Outdoor Rides

⚠️ Safety & Compliance Notice: Max Speed: 20 MPH | Recommended Age: 18+ | This e-bike is designed for recreational and trail use only. Always wear a helmet and check local regulations before riding.

1. Smooth 350W Motor for Effortless Riding

This adult electric bike is equipped with a quiet 350W brushless motor, delivering stable and reliable power for your rides. The consistent pedal assist makes every trip feel easier, whether you’re exploring trails, cruising through parks, or enjoying a leisurely outdoor adventure.

2. 36V 10.4Ah UL 2849-Certified Battery: Long-Lasting Performance

Powered by a 36V 10.4Ah removable lithium battery, this e-bike offers reliable range for all-day fun. Fully charged in just 4-5 hours, it delivers up to 35 miles in pedal-assist mode and 18 miles in pure electric mode. UL 2849 certified for safety and peace of mind.

3. Shimano 21-Speed & 26" Tires: Smooth, Versatile Handling

The professional Shimano 21-speed transmission ensures seamless gear shifting for different trail conditions. Paired with 26-inch puncture-resistant tires, front suspension fork, and dual disc brakes, you’ll enjoy a comfortable, stable, and controlled ride every time.

4. Sturdy Build & Practical Features

The durable aluminum frame supports a max load of 330 lbs, built to withstand regular outdoor use. Integrated headlight, rear rack, and fenders add extra convenience for your rides. The intuitive LCD display shows real-time speed, battery level, and mileage at a glance.

5. Easy Assembly & Full After-Sales Support

The bike arrives 85% pre-assembled for quick and hassle-free setup. Package includes battery, charger, tool kit, and detailed English manual. Our responsive after-sales team is here to assist with installation, maintenance, and usage questions. Please keep the original packaging and all accessories intact if you need to return the item.
